items.egg_link: E-09 念旧之人（19-r2 候选#9，Q17C）
items.prompt: Commemorative silhouette collection scroll, static keepsake artwork. A horizontal unrolled scroll band stretches across the center of the square between two rolled wooden spools: on one single ancient rampart, the six historical forms of the same watchtower stand together as overlapping silhouettes stacked like translucent geological strata. Frontmost, a three-tier wooden watchtower with thatched eaves in dawn ochre-gold #C9915C; behind it a stone bastion with gables and crenellations in bronze verdigris #4E8A6E; behind that a riveted iron lattice truss tower in riveted-iron ochre red #A8503C; then a concrete radar tower with a parabolic dish in electric grid blue #3D7EA6; then a flowing nano energy spire with floating rings in fusion cyan #3FC1C9; deepest, a stargate ring tower in gate indigo #3E55C9. Each older silhouette remains visible as a ghost layer beneath the newer ones, era colors accumulating into rich sediment. Glowing memory-fragment particles drift over the scroll like keepsake dust. Deep neutral night-void background above and below the scroll band. Layered color strata, sedimentary composition, nostalgic keepsake-album mood. 16-bit pixel art adjacent abstract, layered color strata style, flat wide color blocks arranged in horizontal strata, subtle pixel texture grain, clean high-readability silhouettes, cinematic lighting, no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
